name: Cornelia Vasile
quote: Always with a pleasant smile and positive presence, Warren builds improvements and strategic changes. Umbraco savvy, ahead of the game, self driven, leading or being part of a team, be it strategic planning, analysis, development or refined soft skills, Warren is the senior you need, to reach your strategic objectives and build up a team in harmony.
Having worked directly with Warren in complex Umbraco migration projects, I warmly recommend him as the professional you need to turn goals into reality and build a strong team.
